nameEn: Manufacture of optical instruments and photographic equipment
description: This class includes the manufacture of optical instruments and lenses, such as binoculars, microscopes, telescopes, prisms and lenses, and photographic equipment.
includes: manufacture of optical gun sighting equipment
manufacture of optical fibre cables for the transmission of images
manufacture of photographic cameras (film and digital)
manufacture of photographic enlargers and reducers
manufacture of lenses and lens assemblies
excludes: manufacture of computers and computer peripherals, see 2620
manufacture of spectacles and lenses (non-optical), see 3250
